name: Channelizer
description: 80 MHz around the knob's frequency in 64 channels of 1.25 MHz, from 205 us snapshots the radio takes when a burst rises past the threshold (the WHY2025 badge's C6 watches continuously, the MCH2022 badge's ESP32 checks a burst every few milliseconds): channel power, occupancy over time, and the newest burst in time and frequency.
author: esp-sdr
